artworks.title: Chez l'huissier (At the Bailiff's)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays four individuals in a room. In the center, a man stands leaning slightly forward with one hand on a cane and the other in his pocket. He wears a dark overcoat, top hat, has a mustache, and a serious expression. To the right, a woman wears a hat with decorations, a fur stole, and a long dress. Next to her, a man with a beard and mustache holds a hat and wears a suit. Behind a counter, two men in suits are present, one examining papers. The background includes a wall with shelves of papers and a visible window or archway.

artworks.title: Le cabinet particulier (1ère planche) (The Private Room) (first plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a room with a table accompanied by various objects. The table has a cloth covering and holds items such as books, a pen, a cup and saucer, and a wine bottle next to a tray with glasses. In the background, three individuals are engaged in different activities. The person on the left leans on the table, while the middle figure appears focused, and the person on the right reads a newspaper labeled 'LE JUST...'. The setting is dimly lit, and the use of charcoal or dark pencil gives the scene a textured quality.

artworks.title: Le cabinet particulier (3e planche) (The Private Room) (third plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: Two women sit closely at a table with a bottle, books, and a plate of fruit, while a man with a large hat reads a newspaper titled "LE SOIR" at the table's corner. The artwork primarily uses tones of grey, with shading to create depth and definition. The women are positioned slightly towards the left, sitting near the center of the table, with the man on the right end, absorbed in his reading.

artworks.title: Le cabinet particulier (4e planche) (The Private Room) (fourth plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows three people at a table, focusing on their upper bodies. The central figure leans against another person, whose face is turned from the viewer. The person on the right is leaning into the corner with their head on their arms. They have a beard and wear something on their head. The table is covered with a cloth and set with items like a bottle, grapes, fruit, and what may be stacked books or papers. In the background, there is a large window with abstract lines drawn on it. The scene conveys a sense of quiet and stillness in a dimly lit setting.

artworks.title: Le cabinet particulier (5e planche) (The Private Room) (fifth plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: Three people are depicted in a room. On the left, a woman is standing and adjusting a hat. She is wearing a light blouse with a high waistline. Seated at a table are two people; one appears to be a woman holding a glass, the other is a man hunched over a newspaper. The table is covered with items including a bottle, glass, plates, and a book. The background shows an indistinct wall and window, rendered in a sketchy, textured style.

artworks.title: a) L'amour à Paris (Love in Paris) (recto); b) Untitled (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
b) graphite on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a man in a dimly lit room. The woman is adjusting her loose garment and the man is lying in bed, looking at her. The woman has dark hair in a bun and the man has short, dark hair and a mustache. There is a table with a hat on it, and a partially visible painting on the wall in the background. The setting appears cozy and intimate.

artworks.title: La loge de la danseuse (2e planche) (The Dancer's Dressing Room) (second plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a suit and hat looking at a mirror reflecting a woman. Another woman is in front of the mirror, with clothing hanging on hooks on the wall behind her.

artworks.title: La friction au gant de crin (planche au lavis et au trait) (The Massage with Coarse Hair Glove) (Wash and Line plate)
artworks.medium: lithotint in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays two figures. One person is standing and leaning against a large piece of furniture with their head resting on their arms. They appear nude with their back facing the viewer. The second person is standing to the left, wearing a long dress with a voluminous upper half and an apron. Their head is slightly lowered. Minimal background details are visible, and the artwork uses sepia tones.

artworks.title: Le petit déjeuner (planche en largeur) (Breakfast) (horizontal plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an interior scene with two figures. One figure is seated on a bed, partially obscured by draped fabric, facing the other person in the room. The seated figure has long hair, faint facial features, and is wearing a garment that looks like a bed gown or night attire. The other person, standing next to the bed, is holding a book or document and wearing a long dress with a shawl or hooded cloak. A small table with a candlestick, other furniture, and a fireplace are visible in the background. The drawing is done in soft pencil or charcoal.

artworks.title: Trois dessins sur une feuille (Three Drawings on a Sheet)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows three figures. One woman is depicted from behind, standing on the left side of the image. She is in conversation with two men on the right side. The woman has an updo hairstyle and wears a dress typical of late 19th or early 20th-century fashion. The men are standing closely together, engaging in conversation. One man is bald with facial hair, while the other has short hair and a beard. They both wear dark suits, with one wearing a bow tie and the other a visible vest. The background is minimally detailed, suggesting a room or architectural features.

artworks.title: Femme nue, s'essuyant les pieds (planche en hauteur) (Nude Woman Drying Her Feet) (vertical plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph with crayon additions in yellow and green on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude person in a crouched position on a chair, with their back facing the viewer. They have long hair flowing over their shoulder. Their face is not visible. The chair is lightly colored, contrasting with the person. In the background, there is a fireplace with a decorative object on the mantel, and a wall fading into darkness. The sketch is done in soft lines and shading.

artworks.title: Femme à sa toilette avec sa femme de chambre (2e planche en largeur) (Woman at Her Toilette with Her Maid) (second horizontal plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph in red on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: In the image, two figures are shown. One person is depicted in profile from head to thighs, seated on a low, round stool, leaning forward with their back bent and head resting on their folded arms. This figure has indistinct facial features and long hair falling over the arms, with the rest of their body appearing nude. The second figure is fully clothed, seated on a chair to the right, leaning forward with forearms resting on their knees. This person has long hair and indistinct facial features. The background includes a table on the left with a jug on top and a window with curtains drawn on the right. The sketch has a warm sepia tone and is rendered with shading suggesting light entering from an unseen source.

artworks.title: Dans la salle de bains (In the Bathroom)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures facing each other. The figure on the left is mostly shown, from head to slightly above ankle, and appears to be standing. This person has long hair and a neutral expression on their face. They seem to be draped with a long, flowing fabric that covers most of their body. The figure on the right is seen from behind in full length and is also standing. This person is wearing a long coat adorned with fur trim around the collar and a wide-brimmed hat featuring feathers, which obscures their face. They appear to be holding an object in front of them. In the background, there is a simple interior setting with minimal detailing, showing faint outlines of a table and some indistinct objects. The style is monochromatic, done in a loose sketch form.

artworks.title: En soirée (At an Evening Party)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing and talking to a seated man. The woman has an updo with curls framing her face, wearing a dress with dark accents and embellishments. The man has a mustache, wearing a suit with a bow tie, vest, and trousers. The background shows faint outlines of furniture and sketch lines indicating a busy setting.

artworks.title: Scène de cabinet particulier (planche en largeur au lavis) (Scene in a Private Room) (horizontal plate with wash)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people with their upper bodies visible. The person on the left is seated, leaning back with their arm stretched out, and the person on the right is also seated facing the left, with their upper body slightly turned towards the viewer and one hand being held by the other person. The seated individual on the left appears to be a man with short hair, wearing a jacket over a shirt. The person on the right seems to be a woman with shoulder-length hair styled in an updo. Her facial features are softly sketched, and she appears to have a composed expression. She wears a dress with a V-neckline. On the table in front of them are a bottle and a book or box, around which their hands are positioned. In the background, there is a rough sketch of a bed or couch against the wall, and the rest of the background is uniformly shaded without specific details.

artworks.title: L'audience (3e planche) (The Hearing) (third plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in a room. A woman in a dark cloak with a formal updo faces a man in a uniform and hat, surrounded by other figures in similar hats. The crowd behind them consists of people in dark suits, with one man leaning against a railing holding a hat. The setting appears to be indoors, with a court-like arrangement of the figures.

artworks.title: Scène de cabinet particulier (planche en largeur au lavis) (Scene in a Private Room) (horizontal plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated at a table. Both are visible from approximately the waist up. The person on the left is leaning forward with their head tilted slightly to the left. The person on the right is seated upright and facing forward, with their hand resting on the table. Facial features are not clearly defined due to the light, monochromatic style of the image. The person on the right appears to have short, dark hair and wears a light-colored top. The clothing details of the person on the left are indistinct. There is a bottle, a plate, and another object on the table. The background is also indistinct and softly rendered in monochromatic tones, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Le bain (planche en hauteur) (The Bath) (vertical plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the back, bending forward near a garment on the floor. The person's head is slightly lowered, with long hair falling down, partially covering their face. The person is bare-chested and wearing dark knee-high socks or stockings. The backdrop includes a bathtub to the left, a shelf with items in the background, and loose lines representing the floor. The setting appears quiet and intimate, depicted in monochrome tones.

artworks.title: En Grèce (In Greece)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in an open landscape. The artwork depicts a scene with fluid, sketchy lines on a light background. On the left, cloaked figures are gathered, while on the right, a solitary figure stands looking towards the horizon. The background shows minimal detailing of a vast landscape with hills or mountains. The composition conveys a peaceful yet somber atmosphere in a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: a) Scène de grève (3e planche) (Scene of a Strike) (third plate) (recto); b) Untitled (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) lithograph on laid paper
b) black lithographic crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd gathered around a man standing on an elevated platform. The scene depicts an event where a large group of people is focused intently on a central figure who appears to be addressing them. The group is huddled together, filling the lower half of the drawing and drawing the viewers' eyes toward the figure standing above them. The man at the center is depicted in a coat, hat, and holding an umbrella. Behind the gathering, an industrial landscape is visible with structures such as factories and smokestacks under a cloudy sky. The drawing uses soft shading and lines to convey both the mass of people and the industrial setting.

artworks.title: Femme assise, la tête dans la main droite (Seated Woman with Her Head Resting on Her Right Hand)
artworks.medium: lithograph in red and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual in a crouching stance, adjusting something on their foot. They have medium-length curly hair covering part of their face and wear a long garment that reaches their feet. The person is seated in a chair with a simple background.

artworks.title: Les instructions pour la journée (The Instructions for the Day)
artworks.medium: color transfer lithograph on laid Arches paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a room. One figure is reclined on a bed, while the other is seated beside the bed. The reclined person's upper body is turned slightly towards the other figure, with their face turned away. The seated person faces forward with a calm expression. They are wearing dark clothing. A high-heeled shoe is on the floor nearby. The background features a green wall with a square lighter area that could be a window or framed piece. The furnishings are outlined with simple lines, maintaining a soft, muted color scheme.

artworks.title: Les instructions pour la journée (The Instructions for the Day)
artworks.medium: color transfer lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two women in a bedroom-like setting. One woman is sitting up in a bed with her legs extended and covered by a blanket, showing a three-quarters view of her body. Her hair is styled loosely, and she is wearing a long, light-colored garment. The second woman is positioned beside the bed, seated in a chair, and bends forward slightly toward the first woman. Her dark hair is tied up in a bun, and she wears a dark-colored dress. Beside the bed on the floor is a single, light-toned shoe with a heel. The background is painted in muted tones, with indistinct lines suggesting the texture of the walls, and there is a simple, rectangular shape on the wall.

artworks.title: Danseuse accotée contre un portant (avec des figurants) (Dancer Leaning against an Upright (with extras))
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a dancer from the knees up, at the center-right of the drawing. The dancer is shown with her back to the viewer, with her right hand on her hip and her left arm bent upwards, touching the back of her head. She has a bun hairstyle and a slightly turned profile. She wears a tutu with a fitted top and short, wide skirt. The background shows faint outlines of other figures, possibly an audience. The sketch uses lines and shading for depth against a simple backdrop.
